about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Get to know me, my background, and what drives my work.

intro.headline: A bit about myself
intro.greeting: Thanks for stopping by my site!
intro.bio1: I'm a Frontend Engineer with a passion for building intuitive, high-performance web applications. With over two years of hands-on experience, I specialize in React, Next.js, and TypeScript—always keeping an eye on accessibility and user experience.
intro.bio2: My journey into web development started from curiosity about how digital products are designed and built. I believe great software should simplify life, not complicate it. That's why I stay current with modern practices and thoughtful design patterns.
intro.bio3: When I work on a project, I look beyond just the code. I consider the real problem, the business goals, and most importantly, the people who will use it. Great products solve problems clearly and elegantly.
intro.bio4: Beyond coding, I'm passionate about UI/UX design and software architecture. This holistic approach helps me build products that are not only functional today but maintainable for the future.
intro.bio5: I'm always excited to take on new challenges and collaborate on meaningful projects. If you have an idea or just want to chat about tech, feel free to reach out!
